segments.text:
V. 49.
Every one—Who does not cut off the offending Member, and conſequently is caſt into Hell, ſhall be, as it were ſalted with fire, preſerved, not conſumed thereby; whereas every acceptable ſacrifice ſhall be ſalted with another Kind of Salt, even that of divine Grace, which purifies the Soul, (tho' frequently with Pain) and preſerves it from Corruption.
